project_metadata.project_title: Behavior-Based Detection of BadUSB Attacks Using USB HID Monitoring
project_metadata.focus_area: USB Security and HID Behavior Analysis
project_metadata.core_theme: Real-time behavior-based detection of firmware-level BadUSB attacks

problem_context.background: USB devices are widely trusted due to plug-and-play functionality.
problem_context.primary_threat: BadUSB firmware-level attacks impersonating HID devices.
problem_context.security_gap: Existing systems rely on signatures, device IDs, and static policies, which fail against HID-based keystroke injection.
attack_characteristics: Bypass of antivirus and device control

finalized_objective: To design and implement a lightweight, real-time, behavior-based USB HID monitoring system that detects non-human keystroke activity indicative of BadUSB attacks.

additional_references.title: BadUSB – On Accessories That Turn Evil
A Survey on USB-Based Attacks and Their Countermeasures
On the Security of Modern USB Firmware

research_gaps_identified: Lack of real-time behavior-based HID detection.
Existing solutions rely on static device identification.
Log-based detection is reactive rather than preventive.
Absence of lightweight deployable OS-level detection mechanisms.

existing_systems_discussed.limitations_summary: Most existing systems focus on device control, signatures, or post-event logging rather than HID behavior analysis.

design_architecture.layer_2_core_detection: Keystroke timing and frequency monitoring using evdev
design_architecture.decision_logic: Risk scoring based on non-human typing patterns
design_architecture.output: Alert generation upon suspicious HID behavior

comparison_conclusion: Behavior-based HID monitoring is more effective than identity-based or signature-based USB security approaches for detecting BadUSB attacks.

current_final_plan.primary_focus: Behavior-based detection using timing and frequency
current_final_plan.risk_mitigation: Threshold tuning to reduce false positives
current_final_plan.goal: Early detection before major damage occurs
